title: Hydration UI deep startup/runtime dependency audit
scope: Assigned startup/metadata/SDK/common/descriptors/papi/viem/pricing/persistence/hosting slice. Exact locked installed artifacts; no product source edits. First-party hosting and browser storage explicitly separated from external-service directive.
limitations: Direct method/source fault injection supplements existing production metadata browser tests. Not every root blast radius independently rendered in browser.
Pending results measured at120/250ms, never asserted observed infinity; source confirms missing deadlines.
SDK aggregate test mocks family getPools and cannot negate underlying scoped15s deadlines.
All npm runtime packages are code, not necessarily network services; pure math/framework/type libraries have no independent remote uptime dependency.

dependencies.label: Application hosting and executable/static assets
dependencies.requiredness: Mandatory for uncached first document/entry load. Already loaded UI should survive later host loss, but current lazy chunk handler can reload it.

failures.dns_http: Initial missing entry script prevents bootstrap. Warm cached/executed features continue until missing route/service/descriptor chunk is requested.
failures.hang: Dynamic module fetch has no application deadline; Suspense can remain loading.
failures.malformed_stale: Old HTML referencing removed hash rejects imports; wrong MIME/HTML SPA fallback at a chunk URL also rejects imports.
failures.recovery: vite:preloadError unconditionally requests full reload; persistent hosting outage can repeat failure and discard warm state. Loaded-vs-initial hosting distinction is explicit; no app can execute uncached code without its host.

existingProtections: Local font assets use font-display:swap. Existing route error/pending components. Same-origin entry/static deployment; no third-party runtime CDN for framework JS.
remediation: Retain currently usable UI when a later chunk fails; show local retry/reload controls. Keep historical immutable chunks available during deploy overlap; consider preload/cache coverage for essential routes.

dependencies.label: Hydration shared WebSocket RPC

evidence.note: Common library block-health probe explicitly disabled in this UI

dependencies.requiredness: Intentionally mandatory chain dependency; root provider suspense waits identity and SDK context.

failures.dns_http: WS connection failure rotates configured endpoints. JSON-RPC method errors reject required provider/asset work; optional useQuery failures generally local.
failures.hang: Provider defaults bound socket connect 5s and inactivity 40s. They are transport watchdogs, not a deadline for every pending request; incoming irrelevant traffic can keep socket alive. App getProviderData has no enclosing deadline.
failures.malformed_stale: Papi typed descriptors enforce runtime compatibility; malformed RPC messages may throw inside WS message callback. Cached same-genesis chain data survives endpoint switches, but fresh cross-chain switch reloads.
failures.recovery: Same-chain switch preserves query data. UI reloads on refocus if block subscription older than 3min, after2s grace. Common blockProbe is disabled here; SDK watcher uses health recovery.

existingProtections: Multiple primary RPC endpoints; 5s connect/40s inactivity; chain identity cache guard; same-chain query preservation; 3min block-stale reload on visibility.
remediation: No independent external service identified in this transport. Keep optional method/contract capabilities isolated from ordinary chain availability; make primary-RPC recovery state explicit.

dependencies.label: Hydration HTTP endpoint discovery

evidence.note: throw new Error("All RPC providers failed or timed out")

dependencies.requiredness: Currently mandatory before any RouterProvider render when autoMode enabled; WS connectivity is not attempted if all probes fail.

failures.dns_http: Any healthy probe may permit startup; all rejected/HTTP error/malformed probes make getBestRpcs throw; useAsyncFn catches and resolver stays null. Healthy WS with unavailable HTTP counterparts is not sufficient.
failures.hang: Worker 5s default Promise.race bounds fetch and response body and aborts request; UI rpcStatus uses10s. Inline head probe also5s.
failures.malformed_stale: Worker checks Array.isArray, finite blockNumber and timestamp extrinsic string. Genesis hash may be null. Ranked by timestamp; no independent chain-tip freshness/expected-genesis filter at startup. Status queries preserve previous successful result on current failure.
failures.recovery: Cold failure readiness flag remains false; no explicit retry timer after all probes fail. Head cache consumed once. Warm polling keeps last successful status.

existingProtections: Probe race includes body parsing; abort controller; malformed shape checks; rank top3; inline early top5 probe; cached previous status.
remediation: On total HTTP probe failure proceed to configured WS fallback and render shell; expose retry selection. Distinguish same-chain HTTP vs WS availability. This is primary-chain transport coupling, not a separate third-party outage.

dependencies.label: Ping Web Worker and Comlink control channel
dependencies.requiredness: Module constructs worker eagerly; resolver depends on its response in autoMode.

failures.dns_http: Missing worker asset, CSP worker denial, or constructor exception may prevent loading imported module.
failures.hang: Worker crash/message-channel failure has no outer Comlink-call deadline in resolver, despite network probes having deadlines.
failures.malformed_stale: Worker protocol/version mismatch after deployment can fail calls.
failures.recovery: No visible worker restart or inline-main-thread fallback at call sites.

existingProtections: Probe deadlines exist within worker. Inline head prewarm can bypass worker discovery if it has successful cached results.
remediation: Handle worker error/messageerror; add outer call deadline and main-thread/configured-endpoint fallback.

dependencies.label: Asset/chain metadata manifests
dependencies.requiredness: Semantically optional decoration, currently mandatory inside cold assets query and root asset gate.

failures.dns_http: DNS rejection/HTTPnon2xx/JSON parse rejection becomes safe empty factory values.
failures.hang: No fetch or body deadline/cancel signal; one hanging resource leaves cold registry unresolved. Browser verified at35s with healthy RPC, not claimed as measured infinity.
failures.malformed_stale: HTTP200 object with missing/non-array items throws outside fetchData catch and reaches root route error. Metadata payload itself also lacks schema validation. @master mutable resource has no version/age validation.
failures.recovery: Successful empty fallback is cached with staleTime Infinity and no window-focus refetch; no scheduled automatic warming retry. Warm persisted asset cache uses non-suspense query so current usable UI survives metadata query error/hang.

existingProtections: Empty defaults and catch for fetch/JSON parsing; cached registry avoids cold suspense on same genesis.
remediation: Decouple default registry construction from CDN warm/enrichment; deadline including body; validate resources; independently retry recovery and refresh stored icon URLs.

dependencies.label: Passive asset/chain image downloads
dependencies.requiredness: Optional decoration after manifests; no registry await on image pixels.

failures.dns_http: Broken icons/placeholder; normal balance/amount/trade controls remain available.
failures.hang: Browser image loading can remain pending without application deadline, but not awaited by root.
failures.malformed_stale: Invalid URLs/image bytes fail img load; cached registry retains old icon URLs until remapped.
failures.recovery: Image hasError local state; fallback shown if supplied; same component may not retry a once-failed URL automatically.

existingProtections: Image onError and optional placeholder; lazy loading; bundled local UI illustrations/icons.
remediation: Ensure every logo has a local fallback; make retry/reset react to source changes.

dependencies.label: Bundled typed runtime descriptors and metadata cache
endpoints: Hydration runtime metadata over shared RPC on cache miss
dependencies.requiredness: Typed descriptor values required; known metadata-byte cache optional because getMetadata returns null on miss/import failure.

failures.dns_http: No independent remote descriptor registry at runtime. Bundler serves dynamic descriptor/metadata imports from application host. Unknown codeHash or cached-metadata import failure returns null for chain-fetch path.
failures.hang: Imported module promise can remain pending on app-host hang; no application deadline.
failures.malformed_stale: Descriptor/runtime incompatibility can reject typed chain calls even with reachable node; byte caches keyed by codeHash avoid silently using wrong runtime.
failures.recovery: RPC metadata fallback for unknown/unavailable cached metadata; dynamic descriptor import failure retains same rejected module promise until document refresh; global preload handler may force reload.

existingProtections: Code-hash metadata lookup; cache exceptions return null. Separate hydration/current-next-ice descriptors.
remediation: Retain availability for optional incompatible runtime capabilities; handle essential split-chunk failures explicitly and serve deploy-overlap chunks.

dependencies.label: SDK context and required DCA parameters
dependencies.requiredness: Mandatory in rpcProviderQuery before full root render; pure client construction except required chain constant reads.

failures.dns_http: Uses supplied Hydration typed client; no external SDK HTTP service required for context creation.
failures.hang: Required constant reads have no enclosing context deadline.
failures.malformed_stale: Unavailable/incompatible DCA constants reject global context even for UI features not requiring DCA; memoized per context.
failures.recovery: rpcProviderQuery retry:false/staleTimeInfinity; failed fresh context escalates root error; reload/remount needed unless explicitly invalidated.

existingProtections: Shared primary RPC fallback. Context returned only after required constants.
remediation: Separate scheduler parameter initialization from basic chain/client context if partial capability failures must be tolerated.

dependencies.label: SDK pool families and shared router readiness
endpoints: Hydration Omni/Stable/XYK/Aave/V3 runtime storage and EVM calls; optional HSM when VITE_HSM_ENABLED
dependencies.requiredness: All activated families currently required as a combined result for cold assets/tradable assets; Aave and V3 semantically separable.

failures.dns_http: All reads inspected share Hydration client. A family error rejects combined pool result, including healthy families.
failures.hang: Scoped QueryCache reads have15s rejection deadline without cancelling underlying request; background whole seed has60s. Direct aggregate has no outer deadline; bestBlocks$ first emission in resolveBlock unbounded. Aggregate test mocks a family getPools that never settles and shows no partial result; this does not override real scoped-read deadlines.
failures.malformed_stale: Bad contract data/runtime incompatibility can reject required family. V3 missing/zero factory is handled as [] when recognized unsupported parameter. Aave fallback initial reserve enumeration remains required, but individual reserve-pool fallback uses allSettled.
failures.recovery: Rejected QueryCache promises evicted; loadAll finally clears pending; next call can recover. Live pool sync catches seed/sync errors and retries on future blocks, connection recovery, finality gaps and hourly reseed; still combined isReady waits each activated family.

existingProtections: Scoped15s query rejection; seed60s; family reseed/watchdog; QueryCache eviction on reject; missing V3 factory tolerated; reserve fallback allSettled.
remediation: Track readiness/errors per family and retain healthy pools; do not require auxiliary family discovery to populate base asset registry. Bound first block emission and aggregate; propagate stale-family status into routing correctness.

dependencies.label: Hydration EVM custom transport and contract data
dependencies.requiredness: Shared primary-chain dependency; contract failures are capability failures, not independent EVM service outages.

failures.dns_http: No third-party HTTP RPC is used for core custom transport; errors from shared client become query/contract failures.
failures.hang: custom transport has no supplied timeout. Default retryCount3/retryDelay150ms concerns rejections, not never-settling requests. Pool QueryCache wraps many SDK calls15s; direct UI contract reads lack that wrapper.
failures.malformed_stale: ABI/type decoding failures reject per call. RPC provider identity does not validate each EVM contract capability.
failures.recovery: Custom request retries retryable errors; chain endpoint switching improves transport; local ordinary queries can refetch; boot aggregate contract errors can escalate.

existingProtections: Primary RPC pool; viem retries retryable errors; typed ABI decoding; many SDK scoped timeouts.
remediation: Use capability-specific unavailable states and full operation deadlines for direct optional contract calls; avoid silent financial defaults.

dependencies.label: Gamma vault share filtering and V3 bootstrap
dependencies.requiredness: Symbol discovery is awaited inside required asset registry; read failures soften to null, hangs delay registry. Bootstrap V3 reads are feature-query work.

failures.dns_http: Contract method rejections swallowed for symbol filtering. Bootstrap rejection is local useV3Pools query error. Same Hydration evm transport, not Gamma-hosted HTTP API.
failures.hang: No explicit deadline around symbol or bootstrap readContract; custom transport can wait.
failures.malformed_stale: Symbol non-string can throw during toLowerCase; wrong deployed address returns ABI/revert failures. Missing filter data can retain ERC20 vault share tokens that should be excluded.
failures.recovery: Initial assets staleTimeInfinity; endpoint-specific contract mapping. V3 query polls60s/stale30s. Symbols not independently retried after soft failure.

existingProtections: Per-symbol discovery catches contract rejection; zero-address ignored; configured mainnet/lark4 addresses.
remediation: Decouple vault-share enrichment from general registry; validate symbol strings and preserve conservative identification; bound contract calls.

dependencies.label: Hydration spot-price and share-token display pricing
dependencies.requiredness: Optional display enrichment; quotes/transaction correctness continue to require route-specific chain data.

failures.dns_http: Primary-chain failures yield null price via getSpotPrice catch; no CoinGecko/independent external price feed in inspected path.
failures.hang: One never-settling spot-price read holds batch updates for all active display assets; no batch deadline. Previously stored prices persist.
failures.malformed_stale: Decimal conversion errors softened to null. Persisted values lack value schema; initial persisted cache5min age rule applies only during restore. Once loaded prices are not aged by render-time TTL; stalled refresh can keep stale values without freshness badge. store.updatedAt changes only when prices differ, so unchanged healthy prices appear old on disk.
failures.recovery: Subscribed per-asset query staleInfinity; aggregate displayPrices stale10s and updated through subscriptions/block-driven cache interactions. Individual null is isValid:false; missing price is isLoading:true. Same-asset price1 bypasses fetch.

existingProtections: Errors become null/invalid display value;5min restore TTL; separate query subscriptions; no global Suspense on display price subscriber.
remediation: Bound/reconcile per-asset price refresh independently; expose observedAt/status; age live cached prices and validate numeric finite values without inventing zero.

dependencies.label: TanStack Query cache/retry/cancellation
endpoints: No own service; wraps each configured query operation
dependencies.requiredness: Required framework code; query dependencies optional or required according to consumer hook.

failures.dns_http: Browser observed queries default3 retries with exponential1s/2s/4s delay; ensureQueryData/fetchQuery explicitly default retry:false. Global caches log errors only; ordinary useQuery does not throw unless configured.
failures.hang: Retries wait for rejection. No generic request deadline. Unused query abort signal does not cancel underlying fetch; useObservableQuery promise resolves first value only and no error/reject bridge.
failures.malformed_stale: Data schemas are application responsibility. Cached success remains available through refetch errors. staleTimeInfinity removes routine refetch and may cache safe-empty outage outcomes indefinitely.
failures.recovery: Depends on individual stale/refetch/enable policies; root suspense throws cold required query error. Mounted ordinary queries contain errors in result state.

existingProtections: Retry/backoff/cache reuse; non-suspense result error containment; query gc/cancellation infrastructure.
remediation: Specify dependency-specific deadlines and propagate query signals to underlying work; document success-empty versus unavailable; localize suspense/error boundaries.

dependencies.label: TanStack Router and root render boundaries

evidence.note: Code comment documents root loading shell outside provider

dependencies.requiredness: Required navigation; root-level failures affect all root children; nested route failures can retain surrounding layout.

failures.dns_http: Nested route fetch/import error may render RouteError inside current layout. Root provider/registry/lazy service failure can replace entire route root. Resolver failure sits outside RouterProvider and returns null, so router error UI cannot contain it.
failures.hang: Root suspense keeps shell visible but unusable base content when required async dependencies pending. Service-only Suspense fallback:null hides TransactionManager/Web3ConnectModal while waiting.
failures.malformed_stale: Corrupted asset store errors in AssetsProvider can propagate to root boundary; exact final error fallback may itself lack provider context, so not guaranteed full error UI for every root failure.
failures.recovery: Current RouteError offers full page reload. No independent optional-service error boundary in root Services; Suspense handles pending only, not rejection.

existingProtections: Loading skeleton root pending; default route error UI; local lazy-service Suspense; cached assets branch ordinary query.
remediation: Place optional services behind their own error boundaries; keep shell/navigation mounted and providers/default state safe during root errors. Add explicit resolver fallback outside router.

dependencies.label: Background app-version detection
dependencies.requiredness: Optional non-blocking background request and banner.

failures.dns_http: Baseline rejection becomes null; checks catch network errors and never throw into UI.
failures.hang: Baseline/body/refresh fetch lack deadline; hangs remain background and do not gate App. Hung baseline holds every future check; repeated checks can accumulate waiting tasks.
failures.malformed_stale: HTML compared byte-for-byte; transient HTTP200 content mismatch can trigger false banner. Baseline null after startup failure is never replaced.
failures.recovery: Hourly/refocus checks retry refreshed index but never recover absent/hung baseline, so update awareness remains disabled for tab lifetime.

existingProtections: Import side effect not awaited by App; catch; suppress banner while transactions/overlays/tutorials active; reload only on user click.
remediation: Add full-body deadline/inflight guard; reacquire baseline after initial failure; compare explicit build ID.

dependencies.label: IndexedDB asset/account/portfolio persistence
dependencies.requiredness: Storage is intended optional and restore is asynchronous/ungated. Malformed restored asset state is effectively trusted by required root provider.

failures.dns_http: No network service. Open onerror resolvesnull and in-memory data can continue; thrown open produces rejected cached singleton.
failures.hang: No open/blocked/transaction deadline; missing onblocked handling. Initial in-memory fresh registry can still populate because app does not await store hydration. Cross-chain switch awaits cache clear and can be held by blocked/open transaction. Portfolio restore/save pipeline also stalls.
failures.malformed_stale: Persisted records merged without schema or freshness validation; invalid assets type can reach root AssetsProvider.reduce and fail render. Matching-genesis stale registry may boot immediately and refetch background; unrelated-genesis cache rejected by gate. Late hydration may overwrite fresher in-memory state.
failures.recovery: Singleton caches successful/rejected/pending open forever; no reset/reopen on versionchange/close. Writes use async forEach so outer catch does not catch each rejected put; quota may cause unhandled rejections. Browser unhandled rejection alone is not proven to unmount React.

existingProtections: Open/read request onerror softer values; read JSON aggregation try/catch; same-genesis registry guard; in-memory Zustand defaults.
remediation: Treat storage as best-effort; validate restored asset schema; deadline/onblocked/versionchange close/reset; await Promise.allSettled writes; ensure old asynchronous restore cannot clobber current chain snapshot.

dependencies.label: Validated portfolio query persistence

evidence.note: Failed to restore persisted portfolio cache

dependencies.requiredness: Optional initial paint cache; setup is called and returns without awaiting restore.

failures.dns_http: No remote dependency. Failed local restore logs and ordinary queries fetch; write failure logs.
failures.hang: Underlying IndexedDB open/read can stall restore/save subscription setup, but not root render.
failures.malformed_stale: Balances validated array and required fields including bigint, reconstructed as AssetAmount. Invalid cache discarded;24h maxAge/cache-buster; does not validate whole stale upstream financial truth.
failures.recovery: Restore rejection caught then installs save subscription. A permanently hanging restore never reaches subscription; current portfolio fetch remains independent.

existingProtections: Shape validation;24h maxAge;buster portfolio-v1;best-effort catches;non-blocking startup setup.
remediation: Add storage operation deadlines/recovery; keep unavailable vs zero and observation timestamps when cached data shown.

dependencies.label: LocalStorage preferences, RPC selection and price/trade state
endpoints: browser localStorage rpcUrl/rpcList/theme/trade-settings/hdx-display-asset/prices-* and other Zustand stores
dependencies.requiredness: Intended optional persistence; currently provider-resolution writes are required to reach outer startup readiness flag.

failures.dns_http: No network service. Default createJSONStorage catches denied storage getter and gives memory fallback; hydration read errors caught by middleware. Available object whose setItem throws quota/security is not softened.
failures.hang: Browser localStorage synchronous operations; no async network timeout.
failures.malformed_stale: Most default persist stores merge same-version payload without schema. Custom helper validates but returns original invalid JSON on schema mismatch; same-version invalid object is then merged. Head theme script removes invalid theme in normal supported execution.
failures.recovery: Writes propagate after in-memory state updated. Resolver setState throw occurs before setIsBestProviderFound(true), captured by useAsyncFn; component stays null outside router. This entire-boot blast radius is a source-path inference plus directly reproduced provider write exception, not yet full browser quota injection.

existingProtections: Default Zustand storage getter/hydration catches;inline theme/head probes catch;some store-specific validation/TTL.
remediation: Soft-fail all persistence writes and preserve in-memory state; always settle resolver readiness via explicit fallback; reject/reset invalid same-version stored values.

dependencies.label: Bundled English translations
endpoints: Bundled module JSON; no runtime translation endpoint
dependencies.requiredness: Required local UI data with English fallback; network only application-code serving.

failures.dns_http: No runtime remote backend installed in initialization. Uncached translation-containing code still shares application host requirement.
failures.hang: No runtime fetch awaits translations.
failures.malformed_stale: JSON bundled at build; translation-key issue stays text/local formatting concern.
failures.recovery: Deterministic bundle version; English resources local.

existingProtections: Bundled resources;fixed English fallback.
remediation: Keep core translation resources bundled; no runtime-service isolation change needed.

dependencies.label: Bundled fonts and design assets
dependencies.requiredness: Optional visual assets; CSS/code required to render structure.

failures.dns_http: Font load failure uses CSS fallback fonts; no independent Google Fonts service.
failures.hang: font-display:swap permits text visibility while fetching.
failures.malformed_stale: Browser ignores invalid font bytes; appearance only.
failures.recovery: Browser cache/new bundle URLs; no root-await coupling.

existingProtections: Local packaged fonts;font-display swap.
remediation: Keep explicit fallback font families and avoid external required font fetches.

dependencies.label: SDK Rust/WASM math modules
dependencies.requiredness: Executable math required for affected quotes/rewards; no independent math HTTP API.

failures.dns_http: Packaged binaries share app host/bundle requirement; no third-party API request for math.
failures.hang: Lazy binary initialization depends on bundled/built Vite WASM loading; enclosing math initialization deadline not visible here.
failures.malformed_stale: Invalid/incompatible binary/build artifact can fail import/instantiate before affected calculation.
failures.recovery: Reload correct coherent deployment; keep loaded UI/error boundary for optional code failure.

existingProtections: Pinned yarn.lock math dependencies;bundled deployment.
remediation: Serve immutable coherent binary/code assets; verify quote math and isolate optional code loading.

dependencies.label: Bundled runtime configuration validation
endpoints: import.meta.env literals; no endpoint to fetch config
dependencies.requiredness: Current global module initialization requires valid optional service URL literals too.

failures.dns_http: Service outage itself does not invalidate URL literal. Missing/malformed optional config values reject global module evaluation before boot.
failures.hang: Synchronous schema parsing; no fetch.
failures.malformed_stale: Invalid environmental build config throws globally even if optional feature unused.
failures.recovery: Requires valid/rebuilt bundle; not an independent service outage.

existingProtections: Explicit URL/type/boolean validation catches misconfiguration.
remediation: Separate primary required config from optional integrations; disable unavailable optional feature when config absent.

newFindings.title: Available-but-unwritable localStorage can prevent outer resolver readiness
newFindings.scope: Entire boot outside RouterProvider, including navigation.
newFindings.proof: Actual provider store setState throws injected QuotaExceededError after changing memory; source resolver persists at86 before flag93; useAsyncFn contains rejection but flag remains false and resolver returnsnull109. Full-browser blast radius not injected yet.
newFindings.remediation: Best-effort persistent writes; always render/configured-WS fallback when storage persist fails.

newFindings.title: Malformed persisted asset state reaches root render without validation
newFindings.scope: Required AssetsProvider root, potentially replacing root with error fallback; exact fallback robustness not guaranteed.
newFindings.proof: Actual IndexedDB adapter+Zustand rehydrated assets:string without validation; same assets.reduce used by AssetsProvider throws. Root unmount/error blast radius inferred from root placement, not independently rendered in browser.
newFindings.remediation: Validate persisted registry and default/refetch after malformed records; avoid late restore overwriting current snapshot.

newFindings.title: Viem HTTP request timeout ends at headers and does not cover stalled response body
newFindings.scope: Any external EVM HTTP consumer using exact viem2.56.8; core custom Hydration transport is separate.
newFindings.proof: Exact createPublicClient/http with timeout25ms and hanging ReadableStream remained pending at120ms; supplied signal stayed unaborted. getHttpRpcClient reads body outside withTimeout.
newFindings.remediation: Wrap whole network operation including parsing/reading with deadline and abort signal; validate per-feature fallback.

newFindings.title: Later app-host chunk failure can trigger unconditional document reload
newFindings.scope: Previously loaded/warm application; initial uncached application-host availability is physically mandatory.
newFindings.proof: Exact vite:preloadError callback requested reload for each of3 injected events. Effect on deployment outage inferred; no full production-host outage performed.
newFindings.remediation: Preserve current shell and cached route; local retry UI and deploy-overlap immutable chunks.

newFindings.title: Total HTTP probe failure prevents healthy Hydration WS fallback
newFindings.scope: Entire boot; coupling within primary Hydration transport, not independent service outage.
newFindings.proof: All HTTP worker probes rejected => worker throws before resolver flag; WS client not constructed. Source verified.

evidence.note: throw new Error("All RPC providers failed or timed out")

newFindings.remediation: Use configured WS fallback even if ranking unavailable; settle resolver and expose status.

newFindings.title: One activated pool family failure rejects healthy families during cold registry initialization
newFindings.scope: Cold base assets via SDK allPools/tradeAssets; underlying reads are all Hydration.
newFindings.proof: Exact aggregate method V3 rejection withheld healthy Omni pool; next call recovered. Scoped actual reads have15s deadlines; aggregate itself no partial returns/deadline, seed60s.
newFindings.remediation: Separate essential registry data from pool-family capabilities; track readiness and routing availability independently.

newFindings.title: Schema-invalid same-version local preference payload is still restored
newFindings.scope: Affected preference consumers; trade/chart/settings may render invalid states/errors, not proven entire root.
newFindings.proof: Actual helper safeParse failed number validation but returned same JSON, restoring count:string under same version; default Zustand merge trusts it.
newFindings.remediation: Only pass old versions to migration; same-version invalid data resets defaults.

newFindings.title: Failed or hanging baseline permanently disables version awareness for current tab
newFindings.scope: Update banner only; main UI remains available.
newFindings.proof: Exact module probe baseline rejection softensnull; later successful check did not mark available. Hanging baseline held check at120ms; source memoizes it forever.
newFindings.remediation: Bound/retry baseline initialization and compare build identifiers.
